title: 第一百五十章 两大护法半路拦截第一百四十九章 强强组合手下留情
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: 王爷的两大护法分别都是南派和北派两大高手。
两人凑到一起，这可没有什么好事情。
毕竟今天晚上是他们两人休息的时候，他们想着来到这里能够好好的放松一下。
毕竟如今这样的一些情况确实也是比较的明显，时刻也是摆在了他们的面前了。
贾环既然已经带着人出动了，那么就不会停下来，而且这一次对于他们整一个行动来说，那都是相当重要的。
要想接下来对王爷动手，那就必须这一些地方全部都给清理掉。
特别是王爷身边这一些保护者，这一些人更加的重要，如果不清理掉，那么会给他们造成更加不必要的麻烦。
而且后边有可能情况也会变得更加的严重，所以必须尽快的解决掉这一些家伙，这才是最好的一个方式。
选择在半路伏击也是因为如此。
只有半路动手，那么接下来情况才能够变得更加的不错，如果是半路没有动手的话，那么等到他们接下来一些其他的状况可能严重性就会更大。
这一个时候对他们来说，现在这样的一些情况还是非常的明显的，所以他们不能够掉以轻心，毕竟在如今这样的一个状况之中，他们只有先一步一步的去解决接下来面对的一个目标才能够变得更加的简单。
“两个人已经过来了，对他们可就不用太过于客气了，直接下去吧，跟他们交流都不用。”
贾环对这两个家伙一点兴趣都没有。
毕竟对付这样的人直接把他给解决掉，那是情况最好的。
如果没有把这样的人直接解决掉，那么在接下来整个状况之中可能就会出现一些严重的问题。
这个时候还是必须尽快的去处理的，只有这样子，那么其他的一些情况才能够变得更加的简单容易，要不然别的一些状况麻烦，这情况也会非常的多，而且不是他们愿意看到的。
嗦的一声，几个人连续出手。
这两人也是江湖之中成名的高手，没有想到来到这个地方居然还会被人埋伏，这可是许多年都没有遇到过的事情了。
“究竟是何方贼人，居然敢拦在我们两人前面，这简直就是活的不耐烦了，你们是不知道死字怎么写吗？那就让我们两人送你们懂。”
现在狼在他们两人面前的几个人还是贾环的手下。
他们几个人不弄成动作，还有他们各种能力上肯定是比不了的，所以在这样的一种情况之下，他们觉得自己在这一边可是完全不同的。
毕竟这两个人也是成名已久。
他们以前也经常遇到过这种情况，对于现在这样的一些情况，内心深处还是非常的清楚。
嗯就算是遇到一些人敢拦着他们，他们两人也会毫不客气，都到了这样的一个程度了，对于这一些人可就不会有任何手下留情的意思。
content_en:
The two great guardians of the prince are masters of the southern and northern schools respectively.
Nothing good will happen if the two of them get together.
After all, tonight is the time for the two of them to rest, and they want to relax here.
After all, some situations like this are indeed quite obvious now, and they are always in front of them.
Since Jia Huan has already led his people out, he will not stop, and this time is very important for their entire operation.
If you want to take action against the prince next, you must clean up all these places.
Especially the protectors around the prince are even more important. If they are not cleared away, it will cause them more unnecessary trouble.
And the situation may become more serious later, so these guys must be dealt with as soon as possible. This is the best way.
This is also why I chose to ambush halfway.
Only by taking action halfway can the situation become better. If they don't take action halfway, other situations may become more serious when they wait.
For them at this time, some of the current situations are still very obvious, so they cannot take it lightly. After all, in such a situation, they can only become simpler by solving the next goal they face step by step.
"Two people are already here, so there's no need to be too polite to them. Just go down without even communicating with them."
Jia Huan has no interest in these two guys at all.
After all, when dealing with such a person, it would be best to deal with him directly.
If such people are not dealt with directly, then some serious problems may arise in the entire situation.
This time it is still necessary to deal with it as soon as possible. Only in this way can other situations become simpler and easier. Otherwise, other situations will be troublesome. There will be many such situations, and they are not what they want to see.
With a cry, several people took action in succession.
These two people are also famous masters in the world. They did not expect that they would be ambushed when they came to this place. This was something they had not encountered in many years.
"Who on earth is this thief? He actually dares to stand in front of the two of us. He is so impatient. Don't you know how to write the word "death"? Then let the two of us help you understand."
The few people in front of the two of them now are still Jia Huan's men.
If a few of them don't make moves, and their various abilities are definitely incomparable, so in such a situation, they feel that they are completely different on this side.
After all, these two people have been famous for a long time.
They have often encountered this kind of situation before, and they are still very clear about the current situation deep in their hearts.
Well, even if they meet some people who dare to stop them, the two of them will be rude. They have reached such a level that they will not show any mercy to these people.
title_en: Chapter 150: Two guardians intercepted halfway Chapter 149: Strong combination shows mercy
